scoring_engine.description: The Farkle scoring engine evaluates a set of 1–6 die face values (integers 1–6) and returns the maximum achievable score by finding the optimal non-overlapping partition of those dice into scoring combinations. This is called the Maximum Partition Rule and is the single most important behavioral invariant in the entire system.

rule.note: Scores as a single die — no combination needed
Scores as a single die — no combination needed
Must appear in combination to score

combo.name: Six of a Kind
combo.side_effect: Triggers BOMB_STANDARD spawn at chain center

combo.name: Straight (1-2-3-4-5-6)
combo.side_effect: Triggers BOMB_RAINBOW spawn at chain center

maximum_partition_rule.description: The scorer MUST find the partition of the input dice into non-overlapping scoring combinations that produces the MAXIMUM total score. Every die is used in exactly one combination or contributes zero. No die may be used in more than one combination. The algorithm must use exhaustive recursive search over all valid partitions.

farkle_event.description: A Farkle occurs when scoreFarkle() returns score === 0. This means no die in the evaluated set participates in any scoring combination.

consequences.consequence: ALL unbanked points reset to zero (permanent loss)
Farkle animation triggers (board shake, red flash)
In Rally/Heist: lost points enter the Farkle Pool (recoverable)
Banked points are NEVER affected by a Farkle

multiplier_ladder.description: A 6-step ladder that multiplies the raw chain score before adding to the unbanked total. The ladder creates the core risk/reward tension: higher multipliers mean more to lose on a Farkle.

rule.action: Reset to step 0. Unbanked total also lost.
Reset to step 0. Unbanked transfers to banked.

adjacency.rule: Diagonal adjacency is NEVER valid under any circumstance

length.minimum_tiles: 1 Scorer accepts 1-tile chains. Single face-1 scores 100. Single face-3 Farkles.
length.minimum_tiles_game_enforced: 2 useGame enforces 2-tile minimum before evaluating. Scorer itself has no minimum.
length.maximum_tiles: 6 Hard cap. Mirrors physical Farkle dice count. At cap, all non-chained adjacent tiles dim and become non-interactive.

face_mixing.rule: Any combination of face values (1–6) is valid in a single chain
No same-type requirement — chains are evaluated by Farkle scoring, not match-3 logic

backtracking.rule: Re-entering the second-to-last tile removes the last tile from the chain
Only the most recently added tile can be removed this way
Re-entering any other already-chained tile (not second-to-last) is silently ignored

commitment.trigger: Pointer leaves the game board area (pointerleave on grid container)
commitment.rule: Chain length of 0 at commit: no action taken

tile.note: Must be in a SCORING chain to unlock. Farkle chain does not unlock.
Auto-resolves to best scoring face via brute-force 6^n search

spawn_pool_system.description: All tile spawning draws from a pre-shuffled pool with guaranteed equal face distribution. Inspired by the video poker deck model: fairness comes from uniform distribution at pool creation, not from tracking history.

pool_size_formula.note: Ensures pool is always a multiple of 6 for perfect equal distribution

die_pool.rule: poolSize / 6 tiles of each face value (1–6)
Rock blocker slots occupy die pool entries as value 0

pool_rules.rule: Tiles are always drawn in the order the CSPRNG shuffle produced. No skipping, no reordering, no look-ahead.
The pool is NEVER modified to prevent dead boards. Reshuffle is the only intervention — same tiles, new random order. This preserves the uniform distribution guarantee.
In multiplayer: all players draw from the same pool. There is no per-player pool.
When pool empties: create new pool of same size with equal distribution, shuffle via CSPRNG, continue drawing. This is functionally a new deck, not a continuation.

Board generation MUST follow this strict order: 1. Place rock blockers (from blocker pool) 2. Fill non-rock cells with dice (from die pool) 3. Apply Wild/Ice/Lock overlays (from wild pool, non-rock cells only) 4. Normalize (SPAWNING → NORMAL)
Rock blockers NEVER spawn from cascade. Cascade refill uses die pool + wild pool only.

casino_contexts.description: Cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generation. Produces values in [0, 1) indistinguishable from true randomness under polynomial-time analysis.
casino_contexts.implementation: HMAC-SHA256(key=combinedSeed, data=counter.toString()) First 8 hex chars (4 bytes) → uint32 → normalized to [0, 1) Counter increments by 1 per call.
casino_contexts.usage: ALL game events: tile spawning, pool shuffling, blocker placement, bomb target color (when not overridden by Rainmaker role).

non_casino_contexts.usage: Monte Carlo simulation, test suite, non-casino previews ONLY
non_casino_contexts.warning: LCG internal state can be recovered from outputs. Never use for casino.

provably_fair_protocol.step: Server computes serverSeedHash = SHA-256(serverSeed). Sends to all players.
Each player generates clientSeed (random UUID). Sends to server.
All random events derived from combinedSeed via HMAC-SHA256 counter sequence
Players verify: SHA-256(revealedSeed) must match committed hash
provably_fair_protocol.invariant: No single party controls the combined seed
Players cannot predict server seed before game starts

forbidden.rule: Math.random() must NEVER be used for any game event
Math.random() is permitted ONLY for cosmetic/audio effects

normalizer_derivation.description: normalizer = E[sessionScore] / targetRTP Where E[sessionScore] is derived from Monte Carlo simulation. Ensures E[payout] / betAmount ≈ targetRTP over many sessions.

range.note: High blockers = frequent Farkle = lower RTP
Expert play on open board approaches 102% skill ceiling

drift_correction.description: Tracks running session RTP and applies small corrections to spawn weights. Maximum correction per session: 5% of drift magnitude. Imperceptible to individual players. Ensures long-run convergence.
drift_correction.overpaying: Reduce face-1 and face-5 spawn weights by up to 5%
drift_correction.underpaying: Increase face-1 and face-5 spawn weights by up to 5%

house_edge.rally_casino: 8–12% embedded in milestone difficulty (not a direct cut)

bomb_standard.trigger: Six of a Kind chain (6 dice, all same face value)
bomb_standard.blast_radius: 3×3 area centered on bomb position (center ± 1 in each direction)
bomb_standard.gravity: Falls into empty spaces like normal die tile. Fuse counts during fall.

tile.note: Flat — not affected by multiplier ladder

bomb_standard.ladder_effect: NONE — bomb detonation never resets or advances multiplier

bomb_rainbow.effect: Board-wide color clear — all cells of target color destroyed

target_color_selection.normal: Randomly determined at detonation via CSPRNG
target_color_selection.rainmaker_role: Rainmaker player chooses target color during countdown

bomb_rainbow.ladder_effect: NONE — bomb detonation never resets or advances multiplier
bomb_rainbow.note: Rainbow Bomb is the ONLY bomb type whose rewards scale with the multiplier. This creates the highest single-play potential in the game. At ×4.0 with 8 Red tiles: 100 × 4.0 × 8 = 3,200 bonus points.

stone_blocker.health: 2 hits to destroy. Health 1 = cracked (visual change only).

damage_sources.source: Adjacent chain clear (any of 4 neighboring cells): 1 damage
Standard Bomb explosion within 3×3 radius: destroys regardless of health

stone_blocker.role_modifier: Destroys in 1 hit instead of 2. 50pts still awarded.

damage_sources.source: Standard Bomb explosion within 3×3 radius: destroys
Rainbow Bomb if ice cell color matches target: destroys
Adjacent chain clear: NO EFFECT on Ice

ice_blocker.strategic_note: Freezes a die face in place. Cannot score until bomb-thawed.

lock_blocker.movement: Immovable while locked. Subject to gravity once unlocked.
lock_blocker.chainable: true — ONLY way to unlock is being included in a scoring chain
lock_blocker.unlock_condition: Chain must score greater than 0. Farkle chain does NOT unlock.
lock_blocker.on_unlock: Tile becomes normal die tile of same face value. No bonus points for unlocking.
lock_blocker.scoring_contribution: Face value contributes normally to the unlocking chain score.
lock_blocker.immunity: Immune to ALL bombs. Cannot be destroyed by any means.

density_tiers.scaling: Blocker count scales proportionally to grid size for multiplayer modes.

detection.algorithm: BFS from every non-blocker cell. Try all valid chain extensions (4-directional, non-visited, up to 6 tiles). Evaluate each candidate chain via scoreFarkle(). Terminate immediately when first chain scoring greater than 0 is found. If BFS exhausts all candidates with no scoring chain: board is DEAD.

stage.name: Pool Reshuffle
stage.action: Reshuffle remaining pool with CSPRNG. Redraw all non-blocker tiles.
stage.bias: face_1 spawn weight: 25% (normal: 16.7%) face_5 spawn weight: 20% (normal: 16.7%) Others share remaining ~55%

stage.name: Full Spatial Shuffle
stage.action: Randomly redistribute existing non-blocker tiles across all non-blocker cells.

stage.name: Guaranteed Recovery
stage.action: Set ALL non-blocker tiles to face-1 (Red). Every single tile scores 100.
stage.note: Mathematical fallback. Should essentially never occur on boards with 6+ tiles.

pool.name: BANKED
pool.description: Permanent. Never affected by Farkle. Transfers out on session end.

pool.name: UNBANKED
pool.description: At risk. Lost entirely on Farkle. Must be banked to become permanent.

condition.outcome: AUTO-BANK — unbanked transfers to banked, multiplier resets, ROUND_END
AUTO-BANK — unbanked transfers to banked, ROUND_END

banking_decision.description: Voluntary bank: player secures all unbanked points. Unbanked transfers to banked. Multiplier resets to ×1.0. Turn ends. This is the primary skill expression of the game.
banking_decision.key_factors: Current unbanked total, current multiplier step, board state (safe chains visible), die distribution, session objective.

farkle_pool.description: Rally and Heist modes only. Lost unbanked points enter this shared buffer.
farkle_pool.recovery: Archivist role recovers 15% of pool balance per scoring chain automatically.
farkle_pool.purpose: Prevents a single Farkle from ending team momentum. Creates recovery arc.

energy_system.global_mode_rule: Any single player exceeding FRENZY_THRESHOLD switches ALL players to FRENZY.
energy_system.frenzy_end_condition: ALL players must drop below FRENZY_THRESHOLD for FRENZY to end. If anchor player drops below threshold: 2-second instability warning before end.
energy_system.implementation_requirement: Energy tick MUST use requestAnimationFrame (client) or 1000ms setInterval (server). Never use setInterval on the client for energy — causes stale closure issues.

grid_sizes.constraint: Grid size determines pool size (Section 4). Grid size determines blocker count (Section 8). Never hardcode grid dimensions — always derive from player count.

constant.name: VAULT_SPLIT
constant.meaning: 70% of all scored points go to shared vault. 30% to personal score.

constant.name: VAULT_THRESHOLD
constant.meaning: Vault must reach this value before heist becomes available.

constant.name: HEIST_ENERGY_COST
constant.meaning: Player must have at least 50 energy to initiate heist.

constant.name: HEIST_WINDOW_MS
constant.meaning: 5-second window for other players to block after heist initiated.

modifier.effect: Shields 20% of vault from any single heist
Successfully blocking heist recovers 15% of vault to personal score

cascade_system.description: After tiles are removed (chain commit, bomb detonation, blocker destruction): 1. stepGravity() — move tiles down into empty spaces (one row per step) 2. spawnTiles() — fill top-row empties from pool 3. normalizeTiles() — convert SPAWNING state to NORMAL 4. Repeat until stable (no empty spaces below filled tiles)

constant.name: CASCADE_MS
constant.note: Milliseconds between cascade steps. Increase if physics gravity animations are used.

cascade_system.implementation_requirement: Use setTimeout recursion or synchronous applyCascadeSync(). Never use setInterval — causes stale closure issues in React.
cascade_system.gravity_rule: Bombs (BOMB_STANDARD, BOMB_RAINBOW) fall exactly like normal die tiles. Fuse continues counting during fall. Does not pause. Stone, Ice, Lock blockers are completely immovable. Never apply gravity.

wild_blocker.description: A die tile in WILD state. Has an underlying face value but resolves to whichever face value maximizes the chain score.

scoring_resolution.algorithm: Brute-force all 6^n face combinations where n = wild count in chain. Maximum n = 6 (all tiles wild) → 46,656 combinations maximum. Return the combination producing the highest scoreFarkle() result. Performance: negligible at 6^6 maximum.

scatter_trigger.condition: 3 or more Wild tiles simultaneously present on board

effects.effect: Force all player energies to FRENZY_THRESHOLD + 1
Destroy all cells matching any wild tile's underlying face
Score: face-1 destroyed = +100, face-5 destroyed = +50, others = 0

three_way_decision.option: Build another chain. Multiplier stays. Unbanked stays at risk.
Secure unbanked. Transfers to banked. Multiplier resets. Turn ends.

Hand board to next player. Incoming player inherits: exact board state, full unbanked total (from ALL previous players this streak), current multiplier step. If incoming player Farkles: ENTIRE accumulated unbanked is lost.

role_abilities.role: Straight chain → color selector appears during countdown instead of random color. Player chooses Rainbow Bomb target color.
Stone Blockers destroyed in 1 hit instead of 2. 50-point reward applies immediately.
After each scoring chain: 15% of Farkle Pool balance auto-recovered to unbanked. Recovery visible before Continue/Bank/Pass decision.

When Conductor chooses PASS (not Continue or Bank): Multiplier advances one additional step before incoming player begins. Conductor passing at ×2.0 → incoming player receives board at ×3.0. Bonus applies ONLY on Pass. Banking forfeits the boost.

implementation_warnings.warning: Do not use Math.random() for tile spawning, pool shuffling, or any game event. Using Math.random() breaks provably fair guarantees and makes sessions unverifiable.

Do not apply the multiplier ladder to Standard Bomb tile rewards. Standard Bomb pays flat 100pts/die and 50pts/Stone regardless of multiplier. Only Rainbow Bomb rewards (Red and Blue tiles) scale with the multiplier.
Do not allow bomb detonation to reset or advance the multiplier ladder. Bombs are interruptions to the chain streak — they must not interact with ladder state.
Do not allow Lock Blockers to be destroyed by bombs. Lock Blockers are immune to ALL bombs. This is intentional — they can only be unlocked by inclusion in a scoring chain.
Do not use the Three-of-a-Kind formula (face × 100) for Three 1s. Three 1s = 1000, always. 1 × 100 = 100 is wrong. This is the most common error.

The maximum partition rule requires exhaustive search. Greedy approaches (take the first/largest combination found) will produce wrong scores. Example: [1,1,1,2,2,2] greedy might score 1200. Correct answer is 2500 (Two Triplets).

Do not use setInterval for cascade steps — use setTimeout recursion. setInterval with React state creates stale closure bugs where the interval references outdated state from the closure it was created in.
Do not use setInterval for energy tick on the client. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth, frame-accurate energy updates.
Adjacent chain clears do NOT damage Ice Blockers. Only bombs destroy Ice. This is often incorrectly implemented to mirror Stone behavior.

The normalizer must be recalibrated via Monte Carlo if blocker density changes. The same normalizer cannot be used across HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW density settings — average session scores differ significantly across density tiers.
